news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.22 (vs ₹5.20 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.22 (up from ₹5.20 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹4.96b (up 14% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹290.5m (flat on 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 5.9% (down from 6.7% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 21% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 14% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Limited Approves Appointment of Varun Dua as an Additional Director, Effective January 12, 2026
news.body: The Board of Directors of Federal-Mogul Goetze (India) Limited at its meeting held on January 8, 2026, approved the appointment of Mr. Varun Dua as an Additional Director Executive Non-Independent) of the Company, as recommended by the Nomination and Remuneration Committee with effect from January 12, 2026 subject to obtaining a valid Director Identification Number from the Central Government. Mr. Varun Dua is a finance professional with over 20 years of experience in strategic and operational finance leadership roles at Fortune 100 companies, including General Electric and Walmart, as well as private equity and venture capital-backed companies.
